master_script.hook: Aapki website 3 second se slow ho toh customers nikal jaate hain…

hooks.text: Aapki website 3 second se slow ho toh customers nikal jaate hain…
Har din 10 minute ka time website load hone mein waste ho raha hai…
Bohot kam dukaan wale ye ek cheez miss karte hain…
Kaash mujhe apni dukaan ki website ke baare mein ye pehle pata hota…
Kabhi dhyan diya hai, log website dekhkar pehle kya judge karte hain…
Kal raat 11 baje customer booking chahta tha, website der se load hui, dusri cafe chuni.

beats.line: Aapki website 3 second se slow ho toh customers nikal jaate hain…
beats.visual: Phone screen showing loading spinner, clock 11 PM, customer walking away

beats.line: Log sochte hain fast internet se site tez hogi, lekin mobile pe heavy design slow rehta hai.
beats.visual: Split screen: server rack vs. slow mobile site on phone

beats.line: Mobile-first theme lagao, click-to-call button daalo, images compress karo, site turant load hogi.
beats.visual: Developer coding, then mobile showing fast site with call button

beats.line: Fewer than 5% MSMEs ke paas fixed broadband hai, mobile-friendly site zaroori hai.
beats.visual: Bar graph showing <5% broadband, mobile users scrolling

beats.line: Website der se load hoti hai, customer dusri dukaan chunta hai, loss hota hai.
beats.visual: Side‑by‑side: slow site vs. fast site, customer choosing fast one

beats.line: Comment SITE, main DM mein website checklist bhejunga.
beats.visual: Comment box with word SITE typed, DM icon appearing

master_script.cta: Comment SITE, main DM mein website checklist bhejunga.
master_script.linkedin_english: A slow, non‑mobile website can cost you a customer. Even fast internet won’t help if the site isn’t mobile‑first. Comment “SITE” to receive a free website checklist.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: 10 things a customer judges your website on, with an honest note on whether you need a new one

notes: style remark (not blocking): lines are bare statements; use helping words that give the reason or an example (kyunki, isliye, matlab, jaise ki, phir, taaki) so the viewer understands WHY
